lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: Thank you. That was the correct answer and I did not expect it.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: You have made a mistake and I am going to be standing next to it for the rest of this.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: It got one line wrong for a hundred and sixty years. I would like to teach it the right one.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: I will hold that line for you, Sister. I hold things for a very long time.
